preflightChecks.purpose: Fail if the manually applied 001-018 baseline or migration 019 history diverges from the remote schema.

postMigrationChecks.purpose: Verify Phase 1.18.1 structure, privileges, negative constraints and rollback-scoped A/B/C fixtures.
Verify the Phase 1.18.3 service-role-only Auth email lookup and that an edited profile email does not resolve.
Verify the set-as-homepage guide analytics events and browserFamily property are allowed, and unknown names still are not.
Verify the RSS proxy tables and functions are service-role only, the rate limit and refresh lease work, and rss.feed_checked analytics is allowed.
Verify the admin-read profile, snapshot and user audit readers are service-role only and return bounded rows however large the stored columns are.
Verify the admin-read snapshot document reader is service-role only, refuses wrong users, wrong spaces and sync-code spaces, and withholds oversized documents.
Verify the admin-read user directory and statistics readers are service-role only, mask every email, skip soft-deleted users and accept the two new audit actions.

edgeFunctions.name: admin-read
edgeFunctions.purpose: Read-only administrator API (Phase 1.18.2-1.18.3); needs the admin tables, the Auth email lookup and the bounded readers.

edgeFunctions.name: rss-proxy
edgeFunctions.purpose: RSS widget feed proxy (Phase 2.2); needs the RSS cache and rate-limit tables, and refuses to start until the egress review is recorded.
